items.title: 68239_Ram Ramirez oral history interview
items.q: Oh, Dave Martin, the late Dave Martin; Eddie Heywood worked for her.

ctx.x: Special material could mean something a bit funny, huh.

Well... Yeah, she would... You had to know... If you worked for her... I worked for her first... But at one time earlier, in my earlier days... I worked for her before... Oh, Dave Martin, the late Dave Martin; Eddie Heywood worked for her.

And so I had a nice thing going, working for her, working for the (?), too. She did special material, like "The Boys Up At Yale," very spicy sort of material. Something like "The swimming of the organ and the coming of the bride", things like... [LAUGHS]
